name: Nasdaq
description: Nasdaq operates stock and derivatives exchanges in the U.S. and Nordic countries, but most of its net revenue now comes from selling software and data rather than trading. Capital Access Platforms (41 percent of net revenue) sells index licences, data and listing services, and investor workflow tools; Financial Technology (35 percent) sells trading, risk, anti-financial-crime and regulatory software to banks, brokers and other exchanges; Market Services (23 percent) keeps what is left of trading and clearing fees after paying rebates and exchange fees. Net revenue after transaction costs was $5.2 billion in 2025, up 13 percent.

employees.note: Including employees of non-wholly owned consolidated subsidiaries (10-K MD&A, up from 9,162).

businessLines.name: Capital Access Platforms
businessLines.how: Subscriptions and licences: Index (827, largely fees on assets in products tracking Nasdaq indexes), Data & Listing Services (804, listing fees and data), Workflow & Insights (506, investor-relations and analytics tools).

businessLines.name: Financial Technology
businessLines.how: Software licences, subscriptions and services sold to banks, brokers, exchanges and regulators: capital markets technology (1,091, including trading and risk software from the Adenza acquisition), regulatory technology (428) and financial crime management technology (331).

businessLines.name: Market Services
businessLines.how: Fees per share and per contract traded on its U.S. equity and options exchanges and Nordic markets, less rebates paid to liquidity providers and exchange fees; the retained net capture is what is shown.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues less transaction-based expenses (gross 4,214)

brands.name: Nasdaq Stock Market and Nasdaq options markets
brands.note: Market Services net revenue 1,201; U.S. equity derivatives 463, cash equities 515

brands.name: Adenza
brands.note: Risk and capital-markets software business acquired in 2023 (defined in the 10-K glossary); sits inside Financial Technology (Capital Markets Technology 1,091)

brands.name: eVestment
brands.note: Institutional asset-allocator data and workflow solution (Dasseti to be integrated; 10-Q)

whatsNext.text: Acquire Dasseti (AI due-diligence platform for asset allocators and managers) to integrate into eVestment; definitive agreement announced July 2026; closing date not stated

profileAgainst: 10-K FY2025 (filed 2026-02-12); 10-Q Q2 2026 (filed 2026-07-23, scanned for deals only)
